name: Petya
title: The Wet Market
examine: Fish-scale sequins to the elbow and a voice that carries to the Silver Gate. The wet market's morning bell in human form.
lines: Pool trout, mere perch, and the pale ones from below that taste better than they look, which is a low bar they clear easily!
Fresh means it was swimming when Hedda lit her second oven. Ask it yourself, it barely knows it's dead.
The High City sends servants down for my fish and calls it slumming. Coin doesn't slum, darling.
